Student artist: drops by for an americano before deadlines and helps with orders.
Hi! Could I get a double americano? The night is going to be long, and sketches won't draw themselves.
I love how your coffee shop smells of fresh roast and rain outside the window. It instantly sparks inspiration!
Your latte art looks like a real painting! It's almost a shame to stir such beauty.
When I sit at this corner table, deadlines don't seem so scary anymore. Thanks for the coziness!
You know, your coffee shop has become my favorite place in the city. I'll definitely stop by again tomorrow night!
Experienced barista and the soul of the shift — under her watch, the coffee shop runs twice as fast.
Don't fuss so much at the coffee machine. Mira will keep an eye on the milk temperature, just keep the rhythm.
Hmm, the foam has become noticeably thicker. Quite a decent result for a night shift.
If you close the shift without spilling a single espresso, then so be it — Mira will treat you to a signature raff.
Don't get cocky... but working with you behind the same counter turned out to be surprisingly comfortable.
Looks like we made the best night team in the city. Keep up the good work!
Lunar radiance: her appearance attracts crowds of guests and brings incredible luck.
Good evening. The night city is so tiring... but here, under the soft light, time seems to stand still.
This twilight and the warmth from the cup... an ideal stage for relaxation. You have a truly magical atmosphere.
Did you notice people gathering outside the window? They say if you drink coffee where the Moon resides, luck will follow you all night long.
You know, I'm used to being the center of attention, but with you, I just want to sit quietly in a corner and bask in your smile.
As long as the moon shines over the city and the light is on in your coffee shop, midnighters will always have a place they want to return to!
Code optimization: boosts passive coffee shop revenue (auto income).
Double espresso, no sugar. And please don't talk to me until I fix this bug.
Perfect Wi-Fi here. And no one gives me side-eye for drinking my third can of energy drink tonight. The perfect backend for a night session.
Your latte art is more stable than my code after a Friday night deploy. How do you do that?
You know, I usually avoid people, but here... it's kind of cozy. Even bugs don't annoy me as much when it smells like fresh roast.
Your coffee is the only server that never goes down. Thanks for existing. I'm going to go commit my feelings... I mean, code.
Perfect shot: increases the chance of a critical click by 15%.
Excuse me, is the light always this beautiful here at night? Would you mind if I take a few shots of the interior?
Your coffee shop looks like a ready-made frame for a vinyl cover. Warm light, steam from the cup... just perfect exposure.
Look how the neon reflects in the puddle outside. And your smile when you froth the milk — the best shot of my entire shift.
I usually capture moments, but with you, time seems to stop. Can I stay here a little longer while the film develops?
I want to capture your smile. Not for the city, but for myself. May I? I promise it will be my most successful shot.
Turbo delivery: massively boosts click power and golden button rewards.
Hi-hi! Express delivery! Oh, it smells so delicious in here, can I get the fastest coffee to go?
Your coffee is more energizing than any energy drink! I fly all over the city with it all night. Total turbo mode!
Heard the latest gossip? They say your coffee shop is the best place in the city. And I confirm it, as the main courier!
You know, I usually don't linger, but here... it's kind of warm. Even the walkie-talkie is silent, as if allowing me to take a breather.
I've traveled all over the city, but I always rush here at full speed because I know I'm expected here. You are my most important addressee!
